people.name: Ahikam
people.line: Son of Shaphan, protected Jeremiah from death

people.name: Gedaliah
people.line: Appointed governor of Judah by Babylonians; assassinated by Ishmael.

people.name: Gibeon
people.line: Hivite city that tricked Joshua into a peace treaty.

people.name: Ishmael
people.line: Assassinated Gedaliah the governor; led captives to Ammon.

people.name: Johanan
people.line: A Judean military leader after the fall of Jerusalem

people.name: Mizpah
people.line: A city in Benjamin; a place of gathering and judgment

translations.web: Then Johanan the son of Kareah and all the captains of the forces who were with him took all the remnant of the people whom he had recovered from Ishmael the son of Nethaniah, from Mizpah, after he had killed Gedaliah the son of Ahikam, the men of war, with the women, the children, and the eunuchs, whom he had brought back from Gibeon.
translations.bsb: Then Johanan son of Kareah and all the commanders of the armies with him took the whole remnant of the people from Mizpah whom he had recovered from Ishmael son of Nethaniah after Ishmael had killed Gedaliah son of Ahikam: the soldiers, women, children, and court officials he had brought back from Gibeon.
translations.kjv: Then took Johanan the son of Kareah, and all the captains of the forces that were with him, all the remnant of the people whom he had recovered from Ishmael the son of Nethaniah, from Mizpah, after that he had slain Gedaliah the son of Ahikam, even mighty men of war, and the women, and the children, and the eunuchs, whom he had brought again from Gibeon:
translations.asv: Then took Johanan the son of Kareah, and all the captains of the forces that were with him, all the remnant of the people whom he had recovered from Ishmael the son of Nethaniah, from Mizpah, after that he had slain Gedaliah the son of Ahikam, to wit, the men of war, and the women, and the children, and the eunuchs, whom he had brought back from Gibeon:
